title: LibSQL query through an in-process WASM database
intent: Databases are normally the boundary of a browser runtime, but an in-process WASM engine is the one shape that fits the browser lane. This fixture finds out where that stops working.
source: stackblitz-conformance: LibSQL (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Create a table, insert a row, read it back

knownLimits: Remote database connections belong to the server lane; only the in-process WASM path is in scope here.
